description.value: Sasha Sushi is an established Japanese restaurant in Abbotsford serving dine-in and takeout, known in the community for its modern takes on classic sushi and fresh, high-quality ingredients. Formerly operating as Sumas Sushi Café, it offers a wide menu of creative rolls alongside traditional nigiri and Japanese mains. A touring cyclist on Sumas Way would find a solid sit-down or grab-and-go meal option conveniently located in a retail strip.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (4 spaces) at 92m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for sashasushi.com is active and confirms the business name, phone number, and address (#108-2070 Sumas Way, Abbotsford, BC V2S 2C7), matching OSM tags. The site explicitly mentions 'dining and takeout,' confirming takeout service. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags. The OSM community field says 'Chilliwack' but the address and website both clearly place this business in Abbotsford.
concerns: OSM community field is tagged as 'Chilliwack' but the business address and website both clearly indicate Abbotsford, BC — the community tag should be corrected.
OSM closing time (21:00) differs slightly from the website closing time (8:45 pm / 20:45) — minor discrepancy worth noting.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active sushi restaurant with a confirmed website and address, offering dine-in and takeout — a useful stop for touring cyclists on Sumas Way in Abbotsford.
